v4-review.rubric: Adversarially review the Tasting editorial-coach diff. Treat the redesign baseline (warm-neutral theme, BeanDetailCard morph, Archive/Inventory/Rotation, framer-motion, the existing SpiderChart and tasting coaching/extraction engine) as APPROVED — only judge this change. FAIL if any slop tell survives: a "learn what you taste" eyebrow directly above the H1, the 48x3 gradient accent bar, any gradient button/CTA chrome, the radial-glow mask on the empty-state, accentSoft used as structural chrome (cup-count badge / "6 steps · ~5 min · auto-logs" pills / icon wells), decorative bean-motif SVGs on the invitation card, ⌄⌃●· text-glyphs used as icons, crushed caps letter-spacing, twee copy ("the more you taste, the more you taste" / "Let's taste something together"), or the 3px caramel left-stripe on journal cards (R1, R3, R5, R7). FAIL if a journal entry does not lead with its ★ rating + one-word + a note pull-quote, or does not show a radar taste-fingerprint of its axes, or the fingerprint/quote can render empty/crash when fields are sparse (must degrade) (R2). FAIL if the guided coaching flow lost any of the 6 steps, the step spine, the tappable glossary teach-me, the spider/scorecard peek, the extraction-review card, or the live-building fingerprint, or if it changed the message/marker/extraction/state machine rather than just restyling it (R4, R8). FAIL if motion is not transform/opacity-only, exceeds 300ms (non-spring), bounce > 0.3, or is not reduced-motion gated (R6). FAIL if gold/accent is used beyond CTA + rating + active state, or tabular-nums/hairline regressed (R7). FAIL if ANY feature regressed — guided/manual add, edit, delete, rating, the 9 tasting fields, AI extraction, sort, share capture, paywall gate, or the BrewTimer→tasting handoff (R8). FAIL if the diff touches Firebase, the tasting/bean data model, or AI logic (claude/gemini libs, prompts, markers, score extraction), or regresses shared StarRating/SpiderChart for other tabs (R9). PASS only when the tasting is the visible hero (rating + words + fingerprint), the coaching is preserved + elevated, the slop is gone, motion is tasteful + gated, and the diff is scope-clean.

v5-human.prompt: On the dev app (device): open Tasting and confirm the journal feels Apple-caliber — each cup leads with its rating + your words and shows its taste-fingerprint shape, no left-stripe, no eyebrow/ gradient-bar; run a FULL guided tasting with Ruphus and confirm it feels immersive, the step spine + glossary teach-me + live fingerprint + extraction-review all work and still teach; confirm manual add, edit, delete, sort, and share still work — proving R1, R2, R3, R4, R8 and the overall feel.

goal.definition_of_done: The Tasting masthead has no "learn what you taste" eyebrow-over-H1 and no gradient accent bar — a clean Fraunces title + a tabular-nums stat line; each journal entry leads with its ★ rating + one-word + a note pull-quote and shows a radar taste-fingerprint of its axes, with the 3px left-stripe gone and graceful degrade when fields are sparse; the invitation/coach hero drops the bean-motif SVGs, gradient fills, and accentSoft sub-promise pills for a clean scaffolded "Start guided tasting" CTA with the on-deck bean picker; a guided session keeps all 6 steps and renders a refined step spine (no glow), editorial Ruphus cards, a live-building fingerprint, the tappable glossary teach-me, the spider/ scorecard peek, and the extraction-review card; the ⌄⌃●· glyph-icons are replaced or removed; motion (journal reveal stagger, spring, haptics, fingerprint animate-in) is transform/opacity-only and reduced-motion disables it; gold is scarce (CTA + rating + active) with no gradient button chrome or accentSoft structural fills; copy is concrete + novice-friendly with the glossary scaffolding intact; every feature is preserved (guided + manual add, edit, delete, rating, all 9 fields, AI extraction + coaching, glossary, spider, share capture, sort, paywall gate, BrewTimer handoff); no Firebase/ data-model/AI-logic is touched; `npx vite build` exits 0; the Tasting Playwright harness shows rating-led journal entries with a fingerprint SVG, no left-stripe, no eyebrow/gradient-bar, no hero motif, the guided session opening to a step spine, reduced-motion with no reveal, and zero console errors; verify-archive and verify-inventory still PASS; codex review is clean against the rubric; and Tal signs off on device that the journal feels Apple-caliber with each cup's fingerprint and a full guided tasting with Ruphus feels immersive and still teaches.
goal.statement: 100x the Tasting tab to Apple-caliber while making the tasting itself the hero: each journal cup becomes an editorial entry led by its ★ rating + one-word + a note pull-quote, carrying a radar "taste-fingerprint" of its aroma/acidity/sweetness/body/finish; AND the 6-step guided coaching flow with Ruphus is kept and elevated into a calm, immersive learning moment. Kill the slop tells (eyebrow-over-H1 + gradient accent bar, gradient button chrome + radial glow, accentSoft pill spam, decorative bean motifs, ⌄⌃●· glyph-icons, crushed caps tracking, twee copy, and the 3px caramel left-stripe on every journal card). Presentation only — no Firebase, tasting data model, or AI logic (claude/gemini, score extraction, coaching prompts) changes; dev channel only.

scope_guard: Do NOT change Firebase, the tasting/bean data model, or any AI logic (claude/gemini libs, coaching prompts, term/step markers, score extraction) — reskin their output only.

Do NOT lose or alter any feature — guided + manual add, edit, delete, rating, all 9 tasting fields, AI extraction, the 6-step coaching, glossary teach-me, spider/scorecard, share capture, sort, paywall gate, BrewTimer→tasting handoff (presentation only).
Do NOT make non-additive changes to shared StarRating/SpiderChart that regress Archive/Rotation/Inventory.
Do NOT introduce gradient button chrome, accentSoft structural fills, glow shadows, or a second accent; keep gold scarce (CTA + rating + active state).
Do NOT animate any non-transform/opacity property, exceed 300ms (non-spring)/bounce 0.3, or skip the reduced-motion gate; do not deploy to production or merge to main (dev channel only).
